I give up. I did not modify `/work/putnam_2008_b6.lean`, so it still contains the original `sorry`.

The statement is the general Putnam 2008 B6 result, quantified over all `n > 0` and `k > 0`, so it can't be settled by `decide` or by checking cases. A Lean proof would need:

1. A reduction of the count of k-limited permutations mod 2 to a determinant over GF(2) of the band matrix with ones where |i − j| ≤ k (the permanent and determinant agree mod 2).
2. An explicit evaluation, for all n and k, of that GF(2) determinant of a banded Toeplitz matrix, showing it is 1 exactly when n ≡ 0 or 1 (mod 2k+1).

Step 2 needs a real structural argument about banded Toeplitz determinants over GF(2) that I don't have a verified version of. Step 1 also needs a permanent-to-determinant argument that I'd have to build from Mathlib's `Matrix.det` API without being able to read the Mathlib sources. I don't think I can get either step to compile reliably in this session.
